report_name: Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
other_tools_used: Walking Audit Methodology for Liverpool City Region
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify potential for change, analyze cycling propensity in areas close to employment, and highlight the potential for increased cycling levels in the LCR under different scenarios.
other_tools_developed: Walking Audit Methodology for Liverpool City Region (developed with WSP)
specific_evidence_of_impact: Phase 1 funding of £16.7m has been secured, comprising £8.35m of European Regional Development Funding (ERDF) Sustainable Urban Development (SUD), £4.8m LCR Transforming Cities Funding, and £3.5m Local Authority match funding, enabling the delivery of 55km of new and upgraded cycling and walking routes.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT shows that there are many parts of the LCR that are relatively flat and close to major employment destinations, yet currently still only have very low numbers of people cycling.
length_of_cycle_network_proposed: up to 600km of cycling and walking routes
